result.reason: The redline exceeds both playbook positions by requiring 12 months of assistance rather than up to 6 months or the 90-day fallback. It also omits a required data export deadline, standard machine-readable format, and deletion certification. The no-charge breach support, disputed-amount/release restrictions, and continued data-access obligations are additional non-playbook changes affecting commercial terms. Drafting is also weakened by the duplicated section number and uncertainty over what rates apply if the Order Form is silent.
